reason: The only sensible deal pushes me into a filter subscription, and I've been burned too many times by subs I couldn't get out of. Paying $49.99 plus $12.99 shipping for the bottle alone is $63 for a bottle from a brand I've never heard of, and then 5-8 days of waiting on top.
objection: The pricing is built to herd me into a recurring plan. 'Cancel any time' is what every subscription says until you try to cancel, and I don't know this brand well enough to trust it.
would_change_my_mind: Free shipping on the bottle by itself with no subscription, and filters I can buy one at a time whenever I need them, at around $40 all in.
